summary: Improve contribution reconciliation, claims controls and pension reporting with practical exercises. Explore the five-day training outline.
lede: Social security and public pension administration training helps intermediate practitioners connect contribution records, eligibility decisions, and benefit payments. For social insurance administrators, pension operations supervisors, and policy analysts, it focuses on reconciling contributions, applying eligibility and claims controls, and monitoring service quality. Using case data and Excel, participants calculate operational indicators and prepare a management dashboard and improvement roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course suits intermediate professionals responsible for the accuracy, timeliness, and accountability of social insurance contributions and public pension benefits. It is designed for roles that handle pension records, claims decisions, contribution collection, service delivery, or programme oversight.
modules: ISSA Service Quality and Claims Flow
ISSA ICT Guidance and Record Integrity
prerequisites: Working familiarity with social insurance, pension administration, public-sector benefits, or related programme operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use Excel-level data handling.
